findings.title: Stats request failure is shown as 'No harvests in this range' instead of an error
findings.expected: When the stats request fails with a 500, the page shows a visible error and a way to retry
findings.actual: The page shows the empty state 'No harvests in this range. Pick a different date range, or log a harvest' with no alert, so a server failure looks like having no data

findings.title: A From date after the To date shows 'No harvests' instead of the server's validation message
findings.expected: The 422 reason 'The From date must be on or before the To date.' is shown
findings.actual: The page shows 'No harvests in this range' and no explanation

findings.title: A malformed stats response crashes rendering and leaves 'Loading stats…' on screen with the old range's data
findings.expected: An error message and no uncaught exception, with no stale data presented as the new range
findings.actual: An uncaught 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)' error; 'Loading stats…' stays forever while the table still shows 1 Jan to 31 Dec 2026 data for the 1 Sep 2026 range
